installAgentPrompt: HAX-ta (https://haxtheweb.org) kay computadorapi churay. HAX CLI-ta `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global` nisqawan churay, chaymanta agente yachayninkunata `hax skills install --all` nisqawan churay. Huk kitita `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i` nisqawan ruray, `cd my-hax-site && hax serve` nisqawan qallarichiy, imprimisqan tiyanatataq willaway. Imatapas tikranaykipaq ñawpaqta kitip AGENTS.md nisqanta https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw nisqatawan ñawinchay.
